title: Personal Loans Payments Desk Card: Payment Minimums, Debit Card Limits and Cutoff
content:
The payment limits below are the same in every Personal Loans grade, Personal Loan Grade A through Personal Loan Grade G.

## Limits

| Item | Every grade |
|---|---|
| Smallest one-time payment | 10.00 USD |
| Largest single debit card payment | 2500.00 USD |
| Most debit card payments per loan per calendar month | 3 |
| Same-day cutoff, Eastern Time | 20:00 |
| Fee for a payment taken by a representative by phone | 0.00 USD |

## Definitions

- **Smallest one-time payment**: smallest one-time payment accepted, USD (a payoff payment may be smaller).
- **Largest single debit card payment**: largest single debit card payment accepted, USD.
- **Most debit card payments per month**: most debit card payments accepted per loan per calendar month (integer).
- **Same-day cutoff**: payments submitted by this Eastern Time on a business day are effective that day; later or non-business-day submissions are effective the next business day (HH:MM, 24-hour).
- **Representative-assisted payment fee**: fee for a payment taken by a representative by phone, USD.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Reading |
|---|---|
| Debit card payment of 2500.00 USD | within the card maximum |
| Debit card payment of 2500.01 USD | above the card maximum |
| Payment submitted 19:59 ET on a business day | effective that day |
| Payment submitted 20:01 ET on a business day | effective the next business day |
| One-time payment of 9.00 USD that does not pay the loan off | below the one-time minimum |
